scraped_replies.html:
The problem was in U-boot DT.

&ltdc {
	status = "okay";

	/* USER CODE BEGIN ltdc */
	port{
		#address-cells = <1>;
		#size-cells = <0>;
	};
	/* USER CODE END ltdc */
};

 

The solution was to copy the DT from.DK.

&ltdc {
	status = "okay";

	/* USER CODE BEGIN ltdc */
	port{
		#address-cells = <1>;
		#size-cells = <0>;

		ltdc_ep0_out:endpoint@0{
			reg = <0>;
			remote-endpoint = <&dsi_in>;
		};
	};
	/* USER CODE END ltdc */
};

Now Linux is booting!
scraped_replies.author: DMårt
